translations.app.description: Select one or more pallet groups, set quantities and permitted orientations, and compare available space in the main maritime containers and 13.60 m full-load semi-trailers.
translations.load.title: Load data
translations.load.subtitle: Measurements can be entered in the selected unit and are normalised internally to millimetres. They must represent the maximum actual footprint of the loaded pallet, including any overhang. Quantities must be whole numbers, up to 500 pallets in total per calculation.
translations.pallet.identifierPlaceholder: E.g. ITEM-123, Customer A, Red wine
translations.pallet.identifierHelpSingle: It will appear inside the pallets and in the layout legend.
translations.pallet.identifierHelpMixed: This lets groups with the same size be distinguished by product, colour, or destination.
translations.pallet.mixedNote: Each group can have its own size, item identifier, and rotation rule. Groups with the same size remain distinct by colour/pattern and legend. Mixed-load calculation works on the floor only, without stacking.
translations.pallet.mixedStackNote: For mixed pallets, this version works on the floor only. Stacking between different groups will be handled in a later module with dedicated rules.

translations.results.title: Results
translations.results.subtitle: LoadComposer uses a heuristic engine. FITS means that a layout was found and validated; DOES NOT FIT means that no valid layout was found, not that the load is mathematically impossible. Vehicle dimensions are nominal operating references.
translations.preview.title: Top-view layout
translations.preview.viewTitle: Change both the preview and print orientation
translations.preview.bwTitle: Change the preview and print using patterns and graphic differences instead of colours, for monochrome printers
translations.preview.help: The view selection immediately updates both the preview and print. In ramp view the vehicle is shown vertically: the front or tractor is at the top and the rear opening or ramp is at the bottom. Pallets and the arrangement are rotated, while codes, identifiers, and dimensions remain horizontal relative to the screen and paper for readability. “Black & white” changes both the preview and print and uses patterns and graphic differences instead of colours, for output suitable for monochrome printers.
translations.preview.validationErrorBody: Result cannot be used and operational printing is disabled.
translations.preview.validationFallback: The final geometry check did not validate the result.
translations.preview.validationNote: LAYOUT VALIDATION ERROR. {details} The result cannot be used as a loading instruction.
translations.preview.singleNotes: {vehicle}: {capacity} ({floor}{layers}). Required quantity: {requested}. Placed quantity: {placed}. {placement} The drawing shows only {usedFloor}{usedLayers}
translations.preview.singleComplete: The requested load is fully placed.
translations.preview.mixedFloorHelp: The drawing shows the floor load. Labels show the item identifier, when supplied, and the pallet reference.
translations.preview.operationalPrintUnavailable: Operational printing unavailable: the selected layout does not FIT.
translations.footer.note: Note: this tool performs an indicative geometry check and does not replace operational verification with the freight forwarder or checks relating to packaging, load securing, safety, pallet bulging, actual vehicle tolerances, and operating constraints. This version calculates floor-level arrangements for rear loading. Weight, load balance, and side loading are not yet included.
